params.prompt: Edit the first reference image and change ONLY the size of the trophy and of the arm and hand holding it. Keep everything else exactly the same: the same man, the same face and smile, the same hair, the same beige blazer and white shirt, the same pose and framing of his head and body, the same photo-real look, and the same plain dark charcoal background fading to warm grey at the bottom. The golden cat trophy (the mirror-polished chrome-gold sitting cat with a visor on a round gold base, as in the second reference image) is the focal point of the picture: it is thrust toward the camera with a wide-angle forced-perspective look, sharp and brightly lit. The whole trophy stays fully inside the frame with a little empty space above it, and it does not cover his face. Nothing else is added: no text, no letters, no logos, no other objects. Make the trophy about one and a half times larger than in the first image, and his right forearm and hand slightly larger to match, a subtle exaggeration.
